# Argentina

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.78, by age as below | MICS 2012, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.98 | no survey with infant mortality by wealth quintile; median of the 13 countries of Latin America & Caribbean (interquartile range −1.37 to −0.60; [table](../../ANALYSIS.md#regional-medians)) |
| `mort_gradient` | — | GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $27,847 (2025, World Bank) is above the range the [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md#scope) is estimated on ($1,100 to $18,000); it is not extrapolated, and the library provides no value |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Divide each value by 100 × (1 − p) before passing it to OG-Core ([how](../calibration-guide.md#converting-a-gradient-to-og-cores-units)).
